dI0 - pUrvamuktaM seka AScyotanapiNDItyAdikam | tatra tAvatsekavidhiradhunA vidhIyate sUkShmadhArA netrA~jjanaSalAkA~anurUpaM nirgatA dravapAtrAt | sarvasminnayane iti sarvAkShiroge yathA doShApekShayA vA sarvagrahaNaM | samastanetramaNDale ityeke | catura~ggulamiti catura~ggulaM yathA syAt tena catura~ggulotsedhaM dhArAM kRutvA secayedityaBiprAyaH | yadvA yathA suKotsedhaM secayedityapi | athavA catura~ggulenAkShivistAraM yAvat tAvanmaryAdIkRutya dravyakalkaM kRutvA karpaTe badhvAkShisekaH kartavya iti saMpradAyaH | tathAhyuktam - ‘avyakte~akShigade kAryaM plotasthairguNDanaM bahiH’ ityAdi | atha doShaviSeSheNa sekasya karmaviSeShamAha - vAte kevalAnilajanite~akShirogaH, snehanaH snehakRutasvedaH kArya ityarthaH | yathA - ‘sarpirmAsavasAmajjABedaH syAdauShadhaiH kRutaH | snehana iti viKyAtaH’| raktapitta iti vyaste milite vA ropaNaH svedaH | ropaNastu tantrAntare yathA - ‘stanyajA~ggalamadhvAjyatiktakadravayAcitaH | dRuShTerbalArthaM SItaSca svedaH kAryo~api ropaNam’ iti | kaPe kaPaprAye~akShiroge leKanaH sveda iti leKano doShaleKana iti, sa ca snigdhasya vihitaH | tathAhi - ‘sneho hitotirUkShasya snigdhasyApi hi leKanaH| jA~ggalAnAM yakRunmAMsairleKanadravasaMyutaiH || kRuShNaloharajastAmraSaDKavidrumasindhujaiH | samudraPenakAsIsasrotojadadhimastuBiH | leKane leKanasvedo vihitoyaM BiShagvaraiH’ iti | tasyeti trividhasekasya mAtrAparimANaM kAryaM kAlaM vA adhunA idAnIM tasya mAtrA~adhunocyate ityuktaM prAk tadidAnIM tanmAtrAviSeShamAha - srehaH teShu svedeShu ShaTSatavAkyAni yAvat Bavanti tAvat snehasvedaH kartavya ityaBiprAyaH | gurvakSharoccAraNaM vA | tathAhi ‘nimeShonmeShaNaM puMsAma~ggulyA cCoTikAthavA | gurvakSharoccAraNaM vA vA~gmAtreyaM smRutA budhaiH’ iti | atraikaladhvakSharoccAraNaM vAgiti paThanti | ropaNe svedaScaturBiriti catuHSatavAkyaiH leKanakarmaNIti leKanasvede | ekaSatavAkyaiH kRutvA tAvat svedaH kArya ityarthaH | athAkShisvedasya kAlamAha - Atyantake gade prakupite~akShiroge rujAdiBiH pIDita ityarthaH | rAtrau vetyatra vAgrahaNAt niSAyAH, prathamo yAmo~aBipretaH | tathAhi - ‘snigdhoShNairvAtajaH pittaraktato mRuduSItalaiH | tIkShNarUkShoShNaviSadaiH praSAmyati kaPAtmakaH | tIkShNoShNamRuduSItAnAM vyatyAsAt sAnnipAtikaH | tasya kAlo divA sarvo yAmaH syAt prathamo niSi’ iti || 2-4 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha sekaH | mIlitAkShNa: mudritanetrasya puruShasya sekaH pradeyaH | seka: secanaM, sa sekaH sarvasminnayane catura~ggulAt sUkShmadhArABihitaH | dhArASabdo dugdhAdivAcakaH | sekasya snehAdiBedena trividhatvamAha - sa eva sekaH secanaM vAte ca ropaNaH kaPe leKanaH tasya sekasya mAtrApramANam adhunA ucyate tAM mAtrAmAha - sneheShu ShaDvAkSataiH sekaH kAryaH | caturBirvAkSataiH ropaNe sekaH kAryaH | leKanakarmaNi triBirvAkSataiH sekaH kArya ityarthaH | sekaH kadA kArya ityAha -sekastu divasa eva kAryaH | anyadapi asAdhuko rAtrAvapi || 2-4 ||

dI0 - eSha ca vAtABiShyande praSastaH | aBiShyando netrAmayaH sarasapAkarujaH | ayamapi sarvAkShirogotpAdaka ityarthaH | tathAhi ‘vAtAt pittAt kaPAdraktAdaBiShyandaScaturvidhaH | prAyeNa jAyate GoraH sarvanetrAmayAkara’ iti | eraNDapatretyAdiyoge kShIrasAdhanaM kShIrapariBAShayaiva boddhavyam | tantrAntare~ayamadhimanthanAmnA vihitaH tatra kaNTakArIyutamiti paThanti | tathAca -‘kaNTakArISiPairaNDamUlatvakpatrasAdhitam | kShIramAjaM hitaM seke cakShu:spandAdhimanthayoH’ iti | anyacca ‘pariSheke hitaM netre payaH koShNaM sasaindhavam | rajanIdArusiddhaM vA saindhavena samanvitam | vAtABiShyandaSamanaM hitaM mArutaparyaye | SuShkAkShipAke vihitamidaM secanakaM sadA | pariShekaM sekABidhAnaM payotrAjaM gavyaM vA mAnuShamiti kecit | koShNamIShaduShNam | saindhavamiti sasaindhavacUrNaprakShiptam | athavA rajanIdArusiddhaM paya iti yogaH | kShIrapAkamatra kShIrapariBAShayA kartavyam | rajanI dAruharidrA | eke rajanIdArudravyadvayaM vadanti | tatra rajanI haridrA dAru devadAru | mArutaparyAyepi hitametat | mArutaparyAyaM tat sarvA~ggam akShiroge paThanti | tadyathA ‘vAraM vAraM ca paryeti Bruvau netre ca mArutaH | rujaSca vividhAstIvrAH sa j~jeyo vAtaparyaya’ iti | SuShkAkShipAke ca idameva secanaM sadA sarvasminkAle kRutau vA hitamityarthaH | SuShkAkShipAkamapi sa cAkShigata eva boddhavyaH | tadyathA ‘yat kUNitaM dAruNarUkShavartma saMlakShanetrAviladarSanaM yat | sarUkShaNaM yat pratibodhane ca SuShkAkShipAkopahataM tadakShi’iti | idAnIM raktapittABiShyandanASanArthaM yogamAha -pittABiGAtoBiShyanda eva | yaShTImadhu yaShTI BadramustakaH SreShThamustaH nAgaramothA iti loke piShTa iti kalkIkRutaH | ayaM poTTalakaH baddhena Cedo vihitaH | poTTalakadvAreNaiva tadadharAseka ityanye | tagaraM, sArivA AsPotA, puNDarIkaM kamalaM tadaBAve tadbIjAnyatra gRuhyante | atra kvAtharUpeNa seko boddhavyaH | athAkShisAdanaharayogamAha | ayaM dhArABidhAnopi svedaH poTTalakena badhvA kartavya iti saMpradAyaH | ambake netre || 5-11 ||

vya_text: gU0 - sa yathA - suKoShNam AjaM payaH netre secane hitaM | kiMBUtaM payaH | eraNDatvakpatramUlai: SRutaM kvathitaM | punaH kiMBUtaM | vAtABiShyandam AgataH pAkaM netraM | vAtABiShyande sekaH, anyacca pariSheke secane sasaindhavaM koShNaM payaSCAgIdugdhaM netre hitaM, rajanI haridrA dAru devadAru saindhavena samanvitaM tatsiddhaM ca hitaM | kiMBUtaM | vAtABiShyandaSamanaM tathA mArutaparyAyeNa roge | tathA SuShkAkShipAke hitaM vAtABiShyande vAtaparyaye SuShkAkShipAke sAvaraM lodhraM madhukaM yaShTI etat tulyaM saMcUrNitaM GRutaBRuShTaM punaH CAgIkShIre sthitaM sekAt secanAt pittaraktABiGAtajidBavati | aBiGAto netrABiGAtaH | netrABiGAte sekaH SarkarA sitA~aBiShyande kAlAnisArivA kalisAri | puNDarIkaM SvetakamalaM, raktABiShyande paTavisRutaM vastrapUtaM, punaH uShNAmbunA marditam, ambake netre sekAtsecanAt SUlaGnaM Bavati netraSUleti ||5-11||

dI0 – athAScyotanamAha - AScyotanaM netrasecanaM, taccAdAveva sarveShAmakShirogANAm | uktaMca vAgBaTe - ‘sarveShAmakShirogANAmAdAvAScyotanaM hitam | rUkShoShNakaNDUGarShASrudAharoganibarhaNam’ iti | atrAdAviti nirAmAvasthAyAM vAtapittavajj~jeyam | nirAmAvasthA ca rUkShAdyupalakShitA j~jeyA | uktaMca videhe - ‘aBiShyande~avamanthe ca netrayoH kaPasaMBave | utpanna eva kartavyaM netrayoH kaPanASanam | lAkShyAScAkShNoH parIShekastIkShNaScAScotanAdikam iti | atra sAmanirAmalakShaNaM ca yathA - ‘udIrNavadanaM netraM rAgadveShasamanvitam | GarShanistodaSUlAsrayuktamAmAnvitaM viduH | mandavedanatAkaNDUH saMramBastu prasannatA | praSastavartmatA cAkShNoH saMpakvaM gadamAdiSet’ iti | niSAyAM na kathaM cana iti | rAtrau na kartavyamevetyanena divA kartavyatA~asya pratipAditA | dvya~ggulAditi | dvya~ggulotsedhaM kRutvA dvya~gguloccenopAdeyamityarthaH | binduBiriti | binduparimANaM ca vAgBaTe - ‘pradeSinya~ggulaparvadvayAnmagnasamuddhRutAt| yAvatpatatyasau bindurdRuSAShTau ShaT krameNa te’ iti | leKanAdiShu bindusaMKyAmAha - bindava iti | bindavo leKane~aShTau, snehane daSa, ropaNe dvAdaSa | te SIte koShNarUpiNa iti | te bindavaH SIte SItakAle hemante SiSire ca koShNarUpiNaH koShNAH | evam uShNakAle SItarUpiNaH | eSha niScayaH sarvatra leKanAdau j~jeya: | vAtAdikramAt snigdhAdikamAha - vAta iti | vAto~atra netrABiShyandAdau tiktarasaprAyaM snigdhaM ca hitam | pitte madhuraSItalaprAyaM, kaPe tiktoShNarUkShaM ca AScyotanaM netrasecanarUpam iti | athA~aScyotanaM mAtrAsvarUpamAha - AScyotaneShviti | sarveShu leKanAdiShu vAkSatamiti | gurvakSharoccAraNaM vAk netrasecane tu snehanAdiShu mAtrAviSeShaH proktaH | atra tu netramadhye bindukShepaNatvena sarveShu vAkSatamAtrameva | kecidatra mAtrAlakShaNaM paThanti tadyathA -‘nimeShonmeShaNaM puMsAma~ggulyA CoTikAthavA | gurvakSharoccAraNaM vA vA~gmAtreyaM smRutA budhaiH’ iti | ayaM pATho bahupustakeShu nAsti || 12-16 ||

vya_text: gU0 - athAScyotanam | athAnantaram AScyotanaM kathyate tat AScyotanaM niSAyAM rAtrau na kAryaM kathaMcana | tallakShaNamAha – unmIlita uddhATite~akShNi dRu~gmadhye dvya~ggulAt binduBiryaddIyate tadevAScyotanam | leKanAdau kiyanto bindavo deyAstadAha - te bindavaH SIte SItakAle koShNarUpiNaH uShNe uShNakAle SItarUpa eSha niScayaH | vAtAdau kIdRuSA AScyotanA deyAstadAha -sugamam | AScyotananAmAnyAha - budhaiH paNDitaiH iyaM vA~gmAtrA smRutA | keyaM tadAha sarveShAM AScyotanAnAM vA~gmAtrA hitA nimeShonmeShaNaM nimeSho netranimeShastanyaunmeShakaraNaM tathA a~ggulyAcCoTikI gurvakSharo dIrGAkSharastasyoccAraNaM dvayaM vA~gmAtrA ekA || 12-16 ||

dI0 - araNi: agnimanthaBedaH tadaBAve agnimantha eva dviguNaH kArya iti pariBAShoktatvAt | athAnyaprakAramAha - lodhro vRukShaviSeShaH tasya tvak tvaca eva lodhrasaMj~jA viKyAtA | atra strIdugdhaM saMmiSryAScyotanaM kAryamiti vyavahAraH | tantrAntare~api ‘nimbasya patraiH parilipya lodhnaM svedAgninA cUrNamathApi kalkam | AScyotanaM mAnuShadugdhayuktaM pittAsradAhApahamagryamukta’miti | aparamapi ‘triPalAScyotanaM netre sarvABiShyandanASanam’ | triPalAScyotanamiti kvAtharUpam | athavAhimakaShAyarUpaM boddhavyaM kalkarUpamityeke | yaduktaM ‘jAtA rogA vinaSyanti na Bavanti kadAcana | triPalAyAH kaShAyeNa prAtarnayanadhAvanaH || strIstanyAScyotanaM netre raktapittAnilArtijit | kShIrasarpirGRutaM cApi vAtaraktarujaM jayet’ | kShIrasarpiriti dohanamAtreNaivotpannaM taM haiya~ggavInamityAhuH | kShIramatra gavyam | tathAca ‘gavyakShIrotthitaM sarpistarpaNArthaM vidhIyate | dRuShTiprasAdanaM SreShThaM timirasyApi karShaNa’miti | yadvA kShIreNa sAdhitaM sarpiH kShIrasarpiH GRutamiti kevalaM gavyamAjaM vA grAhyam | strIstanyAdiyogoyamapi AgantujadoShe praSasta ityAhuH | tantrAntarIyoktatvAt | yaduktam ‘AgantudoShaM prasamIkShya kAryaM vaktroShmaNA svedanamAditastu | AScyotanaM strIpayasA ca sadyo yaccApi pittakShatajApahaM syAt’ iti || 17-20 ||

vya_text: gU0 – tadyathA - bilvAdipa~jcamUlena ‘bilvAgnimanthasyonAkapATalA kumBakArA bRuhatI kaNTakArI vAtABiShyande ambu jalaM tatpiShTairnimbapatrairlodhrasya tvacaM lepayet | tAM tvagninA pratApya piShTvA tadrasaH netrapUraNAd aBiShyandaM vinASayet | raktavAtapittABiShyande kShIrasarpirdugdhaGRutaiH | GRutaM manthanotthaM, AScyotane aBiShyandaSUle || 17-20 ||

dI0 - vraNeShvapi nibadhyata iti | vraNamatra SastrakShArAgnikRutaM jalaukApAtanakRutaM vA tatraiva boddhavyam | anyadvraNaM ca yannetrayordoShajanitam | tathAgantuje piNDIvihitA athAsyAgre~aBiShyandAdhimanthayoH karmAntaroktaM SlokadvayamAhureke | etaddvayaM ca prakaraNAntaroktatvenAsmABirapi nAtra varNitam | asaMgatatvAt | atha sarvABiShyandipiNDikAviShayamAha - sarveShviti | vAtapittakaParaktasvarUpeShu | budhairiti grahaNena yathAyogyaM dravyAdikaM vicArya badhnIyAdityarthaH | ata eva vAtABiShyande snigdhoShNA piNDikA deyA | evaM pittaraktAdike madhuraSItetyaBiprAyaH || 21-24 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha piNDikA vastrapaTTakaiH badhyate sA piNDikA balikA ca proktA sA netrABiShyandayogyA | vraNeShvapi sA badhyate | athABiShyande SirovirecanamAha SleShmasaMBave aBiShyande tathAdhimanthe netraroge snigdhasvinnottamA~ggasya puruShasya SirastIkShNairnasyairvirecayet srAvayet | snigdhakRutatailABya~ggasvinnaM sveditam uttamA~ggaM mastakaM yasya saH | tasya adhimanthAnyAkriyAmAha - sugamam || 21-24 ||

dI0 - tatra vAtABiShyandanASanI yathA (vAteti) | atrairaNDasya patrANi mUlaM tvak cA~ggatrayaM saMgRuhya kalkamAhuH | kalkArthaM cAtra payaH ityapare | sAmAnyatvena jalaM deyamiti sarvatra | vAtanASinItyanenaiva kevalaM vAtABiShyande kathitaM kintu adhimanthAdInAM vAtarujAyAmapi Sastametat | evaM pittakaPayorapi boddhavyam | atha pittABiShyandanASanArthaM piNDIyogamAha - dhAtrI AmalakIPalaM | atra peShaNArthaM kA~jjikaM jalaM vA sarvatra | mahAnimbo nimbArkaH sa ca vakANaniMbaSabdavAcyaH | atrApyanukte jalam | eke SigrupatrakRutetyAdikaM pAThamanyathA paThanti ‘SigrupatrakRutA piNDo SleShmABiShyandahAriNI | nimbapatrakRutA piNDI vAtapittavinASinI’ iti SleShmapittayoriti | atha SleShmABiShyande yogamAha | SigruH soBA~jjanakaH triPalA haritakyAdikam| atrApi kalkArthaM yathAyogyaM vihitaM dravaM deyam | atha raktABiShyandArthaM yogamAha - piShTvA kA~jjikatoyeneti | kA~jjikadravaBAgena| tadaBAve jalamatra grAhyam | tena pUrvaM lodhraM kA~jjikena saMpiShya paScAt GRutena saMpAcya piNDikA kAryA | athABiShyandAdInAM SothakaNDUharaNArthaM yogottamamAha | atra SuNThInimbadalApekShayA svalpo deyaH | svalpasaindhaveti SuNThImAnAllaGutaram saMyogo piNDIviSeShaNam | tena saMyogayuktA vastrapaTTAdiBiH susaMhatA ityarthaH | eke saMyogAditi pa~jcamyantaM paThanti | tatrAsyAH saMyogAdeva SothAdayo yAntIti BAvaH || 25-29 ||

dI0 – yaShTI madhuyaShTI | eke yaShTIsthAne pathyAM paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | pathyA harItakI sindhUtthaM saindhavaM dArvI haridrA tArkShyaM rasA~jjanaM tadaBAve dAruharidrA dviguNA grAhyA taddravatvAt aparamapi vakShyamANacatuShTayaM sarvanetrAmaye vihitamiti SeShaH | kiM tadAha - rasA~jjanena lepa eko yogaH | rasA~jjanaM dArvIkvAthasamudBavaM dravyaviSeShaH | viSvAdalairapi pathyA viSvadalairapi dvitIyo yogaH | pathyA harItakI viSvaM SuNThI etayordalAni patrANi athavA dalasthAne jaleti pAThaH | tatra jalaM vAlakaM | vacA haridrA viSvaiH kRutvA tRutIyo yogaH | nAgaragairikaiScaturthaH viSvAnAgaraSabdAByAM SuNThI kathitA | badhvA sasaindhavaM lodhraM madhUcCiShTaGRutapiShTama~jjanalepAByAM sadyo netrarujApahaM saindhavamatra manAk deyam | madhUcCiShTaM sikthakam | loke momaSabdavAcyam | GRutamatra gavyaM lepotra punarjalena pracarati a~jjanaM tu GRutenaiva vyavahAraH | sadyo netrarujApahamiti | aBiShyandodhimanthAdInAM vedanApahamiti | ayaH ‘lohapAtreNa saMGRuShTo raso nimbUPalodBavaH | kiMcidGano bahirlepo netrabAdhaM vyapohati’ | nimbUPalarasastu lohapAtre prakShipya tadanu lohadaNDenApi GarShayet yAvat Gano Bavati | eke lohapAtreNetyasya sthAne kAMsyapAtreNeti paThanti mAnayanti ca | netrabAdhAmiti netravyathAM tenABiShyandAdInAmityarthaH | athArmanASanArthaM yogamAha | keSarAjo mArkavaH loke GamarASabdavAcyaH | armAtiraktArmasaMj~jaM, netrAByantaresya pracAra ityeke | prayogarAT prayogaSreShThaH | svinnAM BitvA viniShpAdya BinnAma~jjananAmikAM SilailAmanasindhUtthaiH sakShaudraiH pratisArayet | pratisArayedityanena SilAcUrNaM kRutvA kShaudreNa saMplAvya yojyaM | kutra yojyaM tadAha a~jjananAmikAmiti | guhA~jjanIti loke | sA ca paTalante pakShmasamIpe Bavati | svinnAmiti tAM pUrvaM saMsvedya paScAt SastreNa BitvA vidArya tadanu niShpIDyata iti pUyamAnIya paScAt pratisArayet| ata eva BinnAmiti viSeShaNamasyAH SilailanatasindhUtthairiti SilA manaHSilA elA kShudrailA, nataM tagaraM, sindhUtthaM saindhavam || 31-37 ||

vya_text: gU0 - sa yathA - yaShTI madhuyaShTI, dArvI dAruharidrA, tArkShyaH KarparaM, samAMSakaiH samaBAgaiH sarvanetrAmayApahaH sarve ye netrAmayA aBiShyandAdayastAn hanti | anyacca rasA~jjanaM dArvIkvAthodBavaM, pathyA harItakI, viSvA SuNThI, dalaM patrajaM, kumArI, agnipatraiH etaiH ShaDyogAH | anyacca lodhraM saindhavaM agnau dagdhvA madhUcCiShTe GRute kRutam etatpiShTam a~jjanalepAByAM sadyo netrarujApahaM Bavati | anyacca sugamam | athArmasu lepaH maricaM saMcUrNayitvA keSarAjo BRu~ggarAjaH, tasya svarasamardanAt punaH lepanAt eShaH prayogarAT armaNAM nASaM karoti | arma vraNaviSeShaH | atha pratisAraNam a~jjananAmikAM svinnAM sveditAM punaH BitvA vidArayitvA punaH viniShpIDya pIDayitvA SilA elA nataM tagaraM sindhUtthaM saindhavaM sakShaudrairetaiH pratisAraNaM kuryAt | netrA~jjananAmikA netrapiDakA || 31-37 ||

dI0 - idAnIM tarpaNavidhAnaM darSayannAha - athetyAdi | biDAlAnantaraM tarpaNakaM dRuShTiprasAdanakaM karma vacmi | kIdRuSaM netraM tarpaNayogyaM Bavati tadAha - yadrUpamityAdi | yAdRuSaM rUkShaM pariSuShkamiti vAtABiShyandAdeva | AvilaM kaluShaM SIrNapakShmeti romaSAtanaM SirotpAta iti yathA - ‘avedanA vApi savedanA vA yasyAkShirAjyo hi Bavanti tAmrAH | muhurvirajyaMti ca yAH sa tAdRugvyAdhiH SirotpAta iti pradiShTa’ iti | kRucCronmIlanasaMyutamiti kRucCronmIlanaH AkuMcanasaMj~jaH | yathA -‘vAtAdyA vartmasaMkocaM janayanti gatA yadA | tadA draShTuM na Saknoti kuMcanaM nAma tadviduH’iti | timirArjunaSukrAdyairiti timiraM tu li~gganASasya mUlameva | yataScaturthapaTalagato doShastimiraM karoti tacca nAnArUpaM Bavati | arjunamiti SuklaBAgagatarogaviSeShaH | yaduktaM ‘eko yaH SaSarudhiropamaSca binduH Suklastho Bavati tadarjunaM vadantI’ti | Sukramiti kRuShNaBAgagataM tacca trividhaM SuddhaSukraM SirASukraM kShataSukraM ceti | Sukramatra puShpaSabdavAcyaM PUlIti loke | AdigrahaNAdetAdRuSairanyairapi | aBiShyandAdhimanthakairiti aBiShyando netrAmayaH | ayamapi sarvanetrarogotpAdaka ityarthaH | adhimantho netre SotharUpo rujAvAMSca Bavati sa ca vRuddhenABiShyandenaiva kriyAvatAM tatpuruShANAM caturvidho jAyate | SuShkAkShipAkaSothAByAmiti SuShkAkShipAkaH sarvAkShigataroge paThitaH sa yathA - ‘yatkUNitaM dAruNarUkShavartma saMdahyate cAviladarSanaM yat | sudAruNaM yatpratibodhane ca SuShkAkShipAkopahataM tadakShI’ti | Sotha iti | SothajanetrapAkaH | yataH -‘kaNDUpadehASruyutaH pakkodumbarasanniBaH | saMraMBI pacyate yastu netrapAkaH sa Sothaja’ iti | vAtaviparyayairyuta iti vAtaviparyayo netrarogaviSeShaH | ayamapi sarvAkShigataroge paThitaH | yathA ‘vAraMvAraM ca paryeti Bruvau netre ca mArutaH | rujaSca vividhAstIkShNAH sa j~jeyo vAtaparyaya’ iti | taM netraM tarpaNe yojyamiti yatpUrvoktarogaviSeShe varNitaM tannetramityarthaH | tarpaNaM tu vakShyamANaM boddhavyam | atha tarpaNakriyAyAmayogyaviShayamAha - durdinAtyuShNaSItairityanena SItoShNavarShAsvarUpaM kAlaM tarpaNavihitam | prAptiniShedhatvAt | durdinamiti varShA meGavRuShTyAkulaM dinaM niShiddhaM nAnyat | evamatyuShNamiti | grIShme KaratarakiraNatApitadivasam | atiSItaM vAtAdivyAptaM dinamiti saMBrameShviti BramaScakrArUDhasyevArthAsaMvittiH | aSAMtopadrave cAkShNIti | AmadoShajananopadravasahitaM nAkShi tarpayedityaBiprAyaH| tadyathA - ‘udIrNavedanaM netraM rAgaSoShasamanvitam | GarShanistodaSUlASruyuktamAmAnvitaM vidu’riti | idAnIM tarpaNasya kartavyavidhAvapi karmavidhAnamAha - tarpaNArthI puruShaH prathamameva SoBanaM sthAnamanvicCet | tatra vAtAtaparajorahite iti| etayorlakShaNatvenAgnidhUmarahite iti grahaNaM | yaduktaM - ‘pratisUryAgnirahite nIrujo dhUmamArute | gRuhe suKe nirAbAdhaM tarpaNaM ca samAcaredi’ti | uttAnaSAyinetyanena niScalasya vItakrodhatayAsya cAvarodhaH tantrAntaradarSanAt ‘uttAnaSAyinaH kAryaM niScalasya yathAsuKam | tarpaNaM netrayugale vItakrodhaBayasya ce’ti | atha paScAtkarmAha - AdhArau mAShacUrNena netrakoSayoriti netrapuTayoH | dvau AdhArau kuryAt | AdhAro mAShapiShTImayaH palIsaMj~jaH | klinnena mAShacUrNeneti | klinnaM jalena marditam | kathaMBUtAvAdhArAviti | parimaNDalau pari samantato BAvena maNDalAkArau tenArdhA~ggulotsedhaH dvya~ggulavistAraM yathA syAt kuryAdityaBiprAyaH | tathAhi ‘ardhA~ggulo~ardhavistAraM yathA syAnnAkShirodhakRut’ iti | punaH kathaMBUtAvAdhArau | samAhitau na viShamaiH | dRuDhAviti na SIrNau | asaMdhAviti saMdhirahitau | etena tannipuNena kAryAvityarthaH | idAnIM tarpaNArthaM dravyaviSeShamAha - pUrayennetrAdhArAviti SeShaH | kena pUrayettamAha - GRutamaNDenetyAdi | vilInaGRutasya GanIBUtasyoparitano BAgo GRutamaNDa ityucyate | kIdRuSena suKodakaiH kRutvA vilIne | eke suKodarkairevAkShipUraNamAhuH | tadasaMgatam | athavetyanena dravyAntaramAha - dhautena sarpiShetyarthaH | kShIramathanAtsamudBUtaM navanItaGRutaM kShIraGRutamityucyate | kShIramatra gavyaM grAhyaM tadvihitatvAt | tathAhi - ‘gavyakShIrotthitaM sarpistarpaNArthaM vidhIyate | dRuShTiprasAdanaSreShThaM timirasyApakarShaNa’miti | atha kiyatparimANena pUraNaM kAryaM tamAha - eke tu ‘pakShmANi yAvanmajjanti romavattA yadA Bruvo’riti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca tata unmIlayecCanairiti | unmIlanaM tu SanaiH kuryAt | Sanairityanena karmAntaraM sUcayati | kathamunmIlayettadAha carakaH - ‘tato vastreNa pItena nIlena haritena vA | patrairAcCAdya nayane tataH paSyedyathAsuKami’ti | atha tarpaNasya dhAraNaM kiyatkAlena kAryaM tadAha - vartmarogeShviti kRucCronmIlanapakShmaGAtapraBRutiShu | vA~gmAtrANAM Satamiti| gurvakSharoccAraNaM vAk teShAM SatamityarthaH| athavA~ggulyoH CoTikAsvarUpaM vA~gmAtrAtmatvena kathitam | tathAca ‘nimeShonmeShaNaM puMsAmaMgulyAcCoTikAthavA | gurvakSharoccAraNaM vA vA~gmAtreyaM smRutA budhairi’ti| svasthe kaPe iti prakRutisthe kaPe athavA svasthe puruShe nIroge, nirupadrave ityanye ata eva sopadrave doShe tarpaNaM na vihitamiti pUrvoktameva | saMdhirogajalasrAvapraBRutike kRuShNaroge SuddhaSukraSirASukrapramuKe kaPe ca vikArABipanne ata eva ShaTSatamityarthaH | pa~jcaSatAn dRuShTirogeShviti pitte nakulAndhyapraBRutiShu dRuShTirogeShviti bahuvacanatvena pittaje raktaje vA~aShTauSatAni kuryAt | adhimanthe sahasrakamityasya sthAne adhimanthe navaSatamiti paThanti | sahasraM vAtarogeShviti bahuvacanatvenApi sannipAtAtmake vyAdhau sahasramAtraM yAvaddeyaM | tantrAntare saptaSatamAtrABiH sannipAte vihitam | tathAca ‘vAcAM sahasramAtrA syAddhArayenmArutavyathe | pittaje raktaje vA... ...niva | sannipAtAtmake saptapa~jca svasthavidhau tathe’ti viShayovagantavyaH | atha kaPasnehopanayanaM kuryAttamAha - idAnIM doShAdiviSeSheNa tarpaNaviSeShasya dinAntaramAha - ekAhamiti | ekadinAntaraM granthakAradarSanAt| tathA ca - ‘ahanyahani vAtotthe pittarakte dinAntaram | tarpaNaM sannipAtotthadvyantaraM tryaMtaraM kaPe’ iti | tatra pittaraktAdidoShe tarpaNaM kAryam | vAgrahaNena vAtotthepi ahanyahani kAryaM dvitIyavAgrahaNenApi dvyantaraM boddhavyaM sannipAtaviShayaM eke kaTUShNamiti paThanti | tryahamiti tridinAntaraM tacca kaPetyanukte svasthAdAvapi | pa~jcAhamiti pa~jcadinAntaram | atha tarpaNali~ggAni yasya Bavanti tAnAha - suKaM yathA syAt | svapnAvabodho Bavati | vaiSadyaM netrasyeti | varNapATavamiti varNaM SvetakRuShNAdikaM tasya pATavaM nirmalatvam etena vyaktavartmane BavataH | nivRuttiravalokanapracAro dRuDhataro Bavati | kriyAlAGavamiti sUkShmAvalokanepi samarthadRuShTirBavatItyarthaH | athAtitarpitasya lakShaNAnyAha - atheti sugamam | atha hInatarpitasya lakShaNamAha - rUkShamasnigdham, asrAvilam asrairnetrajalairAvilaM kaluShIkRutaM rAgamAraktatAM hInatarpitanetramiti | atha hInAtitarpitasya netrasya kiMcitprakAramAha - etayorhInAtitarpitayoH | tenAtitarpitasya netrasya kiMcitprakArato rUkShakriyAhInatarpitA snigdhA kriyetyaBiprAyaH || 38-51 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha tarpaNam athAnantaraM tarpaNakaM cikitsitaM vacmi kathayAmi | tarpaNakaM netratRuptikaraM | keShu rogeShu tarpaNaM kriyate tAnAha - yannetraM rUkShaM Bavati | SuShkaM kuTilaM vakram AvilaM malayuktaM SIrNapakShma SIrNaM gataM | pakShma netrarogaM yasya tat | ete vAtaparyantAdayo netraroganidAne j~jeyAH | evaMBUtaM netraM tarpaNe yojyaM | netrarogaviSAradairvaidyaiH yatra tarpaNaM na vihitaM tadAha - sugamam | yatra tarpaNaM na hitaM yena vidhAnena vA tadAha - vAtAdInAM hIne rahite deSe uttAnaSAyinaH puruShasya netrakoSayoH upariBAge klinnena ArdreNa mAShacUrNena parimaNDalau maNDalAkArau samau dRuDhau asaMbAdhau kartavyau | tatra netre vilInena drutena GRutagaNDena pUrayet | suKodakairvA athavA | Satadhautena sarpiShA kShIrotthitena sarpiShA vA yAvat akShipakShmANi nimagnAni Bavanti tAvat kAryaM | mIlite netre pUrayet | pUraNAnantaraM tataH SanaiH unmIlayet | dhAraNe pramANamAha - vA~gmAtrAlakShaNaM gurvakSharoccAraNAdikaM pUrvoktameva | sugamaM cAnyat | tarpaNe dAhakaPAdhikye pratIkAramAha - tataH snehavIryeNa Iritam asya kaPasvinnena yavapiShTena yathAsvaM dhUmapAnena viSodhayet | tarpaNaM kiyaddinaparyantaM kartavyaM tadAha - ekAhaM tryahaM paraM pramANaM pa~jcAhaM vA iShyate | atha tarpaNe tRuptilakShaNamAha - tarpaNe netrasya suKasvapnAdIni tRuptili~ggAni BAvayet vicArayediti pUrveNAnvayaH | suKena svapnatvaM suKena bodhatvaM vaiSadyaM viSadatA netrasya | varNasya pATavaM paTutvaM nirvRuttirnirAvRuttiH spaShTadarSanatvaM vyAdhiSAntiH | kriyAlAGavaM nimeShonmeShakriyAlaGutvam | atitarpitamAha - sAsru-asruyuktaM guru snigdhaM ca | atha hInatarpitanetramAha - rUkSham asrAvilaM raktAvilaM rugNaM rogayuktaM hInatarpitaM netram evaM syAt | atitarpitahInatarpitayoH pratikAramAha - rUkShopacAreNAtisnigdhasya na hInasnigdheneti yAvat || 38-51 ||

dI0 - atha puTapAkavidhAnamAha - atha puTapAkasya traividhyamAha - sa puTapAkaH | atha teShAM trayANAM madhye kaH kasya vihitastamAha - atirUkShasya puruShasya snigdhasyApi puruShasyeti SeShaH | leKano leKanaH puTapAkaH | dRuShTerbalArthaM dRuShTidRuDhIkaraNArtham itaro ropaNapuTapAkaH | sa eva pittAsRugvraNavAtanut | vraNavAtAdayo netragatA eva boddhavyA: | idAnIM snehanapuTapAkamAdau pradarSayannAha - vasAmAMsASritaH | sneha iti SeShaH | tathAca ‘SuddhamAMsaBavaH snehaH sA vasA parikIrtitA’ majjA mastakamajjA sthUlAsthiShu ca Bavati | Beda udarasthatvagasthiShu ca | tathAcoktaM ‘sthUlAsthiShu viSeSheNa majjA tvaByantarASritA | athetareShu sarveShu saraktaM meda ucyata’ iti | dRuSa iti | dRuSi madhye niShevya iti viShayaH | atha leKanapuTapAkamAha - jA~ggalAnAM jantUnAM yakRunmAMsairiti | yakRutkAlaKaNDaH | yadyapi jA~ggalavargo~aShTavidha: kathitaH | tadyathA jA~ggalA viShkirAH pratudA guhASayAH | prasahA: parNamRugA bileSayA grAmyASceti | tathApi keShAMcinmate paMcaiva SreShThatamA: jA~ggalaviShkirapratudaparNamRugabileSayASca te ke jA~ggalAdyAstAn keShAMcit j~jApanArthamAha - eNahariNaparNakura~ggAdayo jA~ggalAH | lAvatittirakapi~jjalavartIrurvAdayaH | viShkirAH kapotapArAvatakali~ggAdayaH | pratudA: siMhavyAGravRu(ShA?)SvakaSRugAlamArjArAdayo guheSayAH | kAkaka~gkakuraracAShaBAsAdayaH | prasahA: mRuduBUrivakavRukShaSAyikAvAnarapraBRutayaH | parNamRugAH SvAvicCaSagodhAnakulAdayo bileSayAH| aSvASvataragoKaroShTrabastoraBramedaHpucCapraBRutayo grAmyA iti jA~ggalavargaH samAsena proktaH | yadyasya doShasya vihitaM tattatraiva j~jAtavyam | leKanadravyasaMyutairiti leKanadravyairvakShyamANakRuShNaloharajaHpraBRutikaiH IdRuSaiScetyaBiprAyaH | kRuShNaloharajaHkRuShNasAravarNatAmrarajaSca vidrumaM pravAlaM siMdhujaM saidhavaM kAsIsaM dvividham ekaM BasmasadRuSaM kiMcidamlalavaNarasaM, dvitIyaM puShpakAsIsam IShatpItaM tuvaraM tadBavameva sroto~jjanamiti | rasA~jjanaSabdavAcyaM tacca dvividham | ekaM sroto~jjanakRuShNapAShANAkRuti dravyam | aparaM tu dAruharidrAkvAthena kRutrimaM pItalohitaM | mastu dadhnastoyaviSeSham | tathAca ‘dadhnastu yadadhastoyaM tanmastu parikIrtita’miti | athAto ropaNapuTapAkamAha - stanyaM strIdugdhaM tadaBAve gavyamAjaM vA | jA~ggalaSabdena jA~ggalaprANinAM vasA majjA medo grAhyaM ropaNakriyAyAM vihitatvAt | madhu kShaudram AjyaM GRutaM tiktakagavyaM niMbapraBRutikaM leKanatriguNo dhArya ityanena vAkSatatrayaM sUcitam | atha puTapAkavyApatticikitsAmAha - vitarediti | puTapAkavyApattidarSane hInAtiyoge tarpaNoktAM kriyAM cikitsAM kArayet | etena tAni lakShaNAni atrA~api j~jeyAni iti granthakRutA sUcitam | tathAhi -‘tarpaNaM puTapAkaM ca nasyArhe na ca yojayet | yAvantyahAni yu~jjIta dvistato hitaBAk Bavet’ iti || 52-61 ||
